title: «El empleado del corredor de bolsa», The Strand Magazine, marzo de 1893

catalog.label: «El empleado del corredor de bolsa», The Strand Magazine, vol. V (marzo de 1893)

parts.text: Aventuras de Sherlock Holmes XVI\. — El empleado del corredor de bolsa {{#consulta e:watson p:paddington q:consulta|Poco después de [[boda_de_watson|mi boda]] compré una clientela en el distrito de [[paddington|Paddington]].}} {{#farquhar q:farquhar|El viejo señor Farquhar, que me la vendió, había tenido en otro tiempo una excelente clientela general; pero la edad, y un mal del tipo del baile de San Vito que padecía, la habían mermado mucho.}} {{#junio e:watson q:junio|Me sorprendió, por tanto, una mañana de junio, mientras leía el British Medical Journal después del desayuno, oír la campanilla y luego la voz aguda y algo estridente de mi antiguo compañero.}} —Ah, mi querido Watson —dijo, entrando a grandes pasos—, ¡cuánto me alegro de verlo! {{#signo e:holmes e:mary_watson q:signo|Espero que [[mary_watson|la señora Watson]] se haya repuesto del todo de las pequeñas emociones de nuestra aventura del [[sign|signo de los cuatro]].}} {{#indispuesto e:holmes q:indispuesto|—Veo que ha estado usted indispuesto últimamente.}} —¿Y cómo lo ha sabido? —Por sus zapatillas. Miré mis zapatillas de charol, nuevas. —Son nuevas —dijo—. {{#zapatillas e:holmes q:zapatillas|Las suelas que en este momento me presenta están ligeramente chamuscadas.}}

src_en.consulta: Shortly after my marriage I had bought a connection in the Paddington district.
src_en.farquhar: Old Mr. Farquhar, from whom I purchased it, had at one time an excellent general practice; but his age, and an affliction of the nature of St. Vitus’s dance from which he suffered, had very much thinned it.
src_en.junio: I was surprised, therefore, when, one morning in June, as I sat reading the British Medical Journal after breakfast, I heard a ring at the bell, followed by the high, somewhat strident tones of my old companion’s voice.
src_en.signo: I trust that Mrs. Watson has entirely recovered from all the little excitements connected with our adventure of the Sign of Four.
src_en.indispuesto: I perceive that you have been unwell lately.
src_en.zapatillas: The soles which you are at this moment presenting to me are slightly scorched.
src_en.directorio: This is a directory of Paris,’ said he, ‘with the trades after the names of the people.
src_en.ferreteros: I want you to take it home with you, and to mark off all the hardware sellers, with their addresses.
src_en.oro: He laughed as he spoke, and I saw with a thrill that his second tooth upon the left-hand side had been very badly stuffed with gold.
src_en.mismo_diente: I happened to notice that his tooth was stuffed in this very identical fashion.
src_en.destello: The glint of the gold in each case caught my eye, you see.
src_en.mismo_hombre: When I put that with the voice and figure being the same, and only those things altered which might be changed by a razor or a wig, I could not doubt that it was the same man.
src_en.hermanos: Of course you expect two brothers to be alike, but not that they should have the same tooth stuffed in the same way.
src_en.palangana: Back I went to my hotel, put my head in a basin of cold water, and tried to think it out.
